summary: Full backend + frontend testing of ArchEsame MVP (Esame di Stato Architetto). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass (categories x12, topics list/detail/404, flashcards, tracce, quiz random/submit correct+wrong+mistake persistence+404, quiz/generate via Claude AI, topics/complete, progress shape with streak/accuracy/by_category, mistakes, tutor SSE streaming with history persistence). Frontend: Home renders with hero, streak, obiettivo, categorie, CTAs. Studia tab: category chips + topic list open reader with markdown + 'Segna come completato' updates progress (streak went 0→1, completed 0→1). Esercitati tab: segmented Quiz/Flashcard/Tracce + category cards; Quiz flow works end-to-end (correct answer shows green check + explanation + 'Prossima domanda'). Tutor AI screen loads correctly with 4 suggerimenti and TextInput+send button. No deprecated Expo packages, no red screens, no console errors. Italian pluralization bug: '1 argomenti' should be '1 argomento'.

minor.issue: Under pytest-xdist parallel LoadScope the SSE test occasionally received 0 deltas (flaky). Runs green sequentially and via curl. Likely test-side buffering, not a server bug. No action needed.

ui_bugs.issue: Italian plural bug: shows '1 argomenti' instead of '1 argomento' (and 2+ argomenti). Simple pluralization fix.
Pressing Enter on the desktop web preview does not submit the message; user must tap the send button. Consider onSubmitEditing/blurOnSubmit for web. Send button itself works.

issues: Overall design is clean and consistent; touch targets look ≥44px; contrast good.

action_items: Fix Italian pluralization for topic count on Home ('1 argomento' vs 'N argomenti').
(Optional) Support Enter-to-send on Tutor TextInput for web preview (onSubmitEditing).
No further critical fixes needed; MVP is functional.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py excludes MongoDB _id everywhere via projection - good.
Streaming SSE endpoint uses proper headers (X-Accel-Buffering:no) - working.
seed_data seeds only when empty (idempotent). Good.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY guarded with 500 if missing - good.
All frontend routes use process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL - good.

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 sequential; 17/18 under parallel due to 1 flaky SSE)

seed_data_creation: None; app auto-seeds MongoDB on startup from seed_data.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Anonymous device_id, no auth. AI endpoints (POST /api/quiz/generate and POST /api/tutor/chat) may take up to ~30s. Use sequential pytest for the SSE tutor test to avoid parallel flakes.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. Two low-priority UX polish items only.
